content.text: 10. MEASURE COUNTER FIFTH GEAR THRUST CLEARANCE
Using a feeler gauge, measure the counter 5th gear thrust clearance.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of snap ring using snap ring pliers

content.text: 11. REMOVE COUNTER REAR BEARING, SPACER, COUNTER FIFTH GEAR AND NEEDLE ROLLER BEARING

items: (a) Using snap ring pliers, remove the snap ring.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of rear bearing, spacer, 5th gear and bearing using SST tool

items: (b) Using SST, remove the rear bearing, spacer, 5th gear and bearing.

content.text: Be careful not to catch the output shaft rear bearing roller on the counter 5th gear.

content.description: Illustration showing tapping out snap ring on No. 3 hub sleeve assembly using two screwdrivers and a hammer

items: (a) Using two screwdrivers and a hammer, tap out the snap ring.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of No. 3 clutch hub using SST tool latched onto clutch hub

items: (b) Using SST, remove No. 3 clutch hub.

content.text: Latch the claw of the SST onto the clutch hub, not the shifting key retainer.
